whenToUse: Text of no fixed length, such as reviews, inquiries, or notes.
People need to see and edit the whole text at a glance.
whenNotToUse: Long text that needs formatting (use a rich text editor).
It must not grow endlessly where the screen height is fixed (set a maximum height).
accessibility: The character count connects with aria-describedby, so it's read along with the field on entry.
Don't make the count a live region, so it isn't read on every keystroke.
maxLength keeps input within the limit, and past 90% the count signals it with color and numbers.
Fit the height to the content but hide the resize handle so the layout doesn't break.
